Cargo-ready. Passenger-ready.
A sports car with room for weekdays.
Compromises are few, thanks to new standard roof cross-bar mounting
points, a 12-cubic-foot trunk, a 60/40 split-folding rear seatback,
expansive rear legroom and wide door openings. In fact, the Subaru
WRX has the largest passenger volume among all-wheel drive vehicles
in its class.2 It’s a commuter, an errand-runner and a track-day weapon,
all rolled into one. This sports car goes anywhere but the garage.
